configuration.ETF_specification: Owning ETF; overlap uses HYG/JNK average
configuration.target: Transaction-to-transaction price change in price points

description: Historical TRACE regression with an ETF-return factor and bond fixed effects.
formula: P̂(t) = P(previous trade) + f(history, ETF return, bond effects)
label: B3
limitations: Predictions estimate observed transaction prices, not directly observed latent fair value.
Current holdings and Bloomberg classifications are retrospective snapshots.
Evaluation dates have already been inspected in research.
Historical B3 source-code checksum was not available in its original run.
Execution timestamps are used without a verified dissemination delay.
training: Expanding monthly fit using earlier observations; original baseline forecasts are preserved.
Common three-model evaluation starts 2026-03-02; January–February supply initial training.

configuration.P0_weights: Exponential time weights; one unit per simultaneous batch
configuration.calibration_policy: Each end date is capped at the previous month-end; shared with integrated P1

description: P0 filters transaction-side friction and stale price noise; P1 updates that anchor with ETF movement.
formula: log P0 = Σwⱼ(log Pⱼ − sideⱼ × h) / Σwⱼ; P1 = P0 × exp(β × ETF log return)
label: P0 + P1
limitations: Predictions estimate observed transaction prices, not directly observed latent fair value.
Current holdings and Bloomberg classifications are retrospective snapshots.
Evaluation dates have already been inspected in research.
P0 uses time weighting, not the later return experiment's size weighting.
P1 state history includes observations outside the displayed target window.
Zero-delay research assumption; actual TRACE publication time is unavailable.
training: Both P1 and the integrated model use the same calibration available before each forecast month.
March uses data through February; April uses data through March. From May, the fixed March spread / April ETF-quality calibration is available.
ETF betas are reconstructed fixed conventions, not new estimates from this dashboard.

configuration.target: current transaction price minus fold-calibrated P1, in price points
configuration.training_history: all eligible prior months, including January-February before B3 evaluation

description: A B3-style residual regression corrects P1, using P1 as its single price anchor.
formula: P̂(t) = P1_fold(t) + ĝ(observed price − P1_fold | non-ETF B3 controls)
label: Integrated · P1 → B3
limitations: Predictions estimate observed transaction prices, not directly observed latent fair value.
Current holdings and Bloomberg classifications are retrospective snapshots.
Evaluation dates have already been inspected in research.
Unseen bonds receive the omitted fixed-effect category, not an average issuer effect.
Training anchors are fitted inputs, not out-of-sample predictions. Training histories can differ across models.
P1-to-integrated differences isolate the added residual correction on identical targets.
training: January–February provide initial training; monthly forecasts run March–September using all eligible prior outcomes.
The P1 anchor is identical to the standalone P1 benchmark in every evaluation month.
P1 calibration and residual regression are fitted within the historical training fold; neither uses evaluation-month outcomes.
P0, P1 levels, last-price levels, ETF returns and current pricing gaps are excluded from regressors.
